skills.name: humanizer
skills.purpose: Rewrites AI-sounding text to read like the writer without changing meaning; targets patterns from Wikipedia's 'Signs of AI writing' (dash overuse, triads, inflated claims, stock AI words).
skills.how_to_use: Ask to humanize or de-AI a draft; no prerequisites.
skills.evidence: 53.6k stars (top writing skill on GitHub); in skillsmp humanizer results; copied by aitmpl/claude-code-templates and others

skills.name: copywriting
skills.purpose: Writes/rewrites marketing copy for homepage, landing, pricing, feature pages: headlines, value props, CTAs.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'write copy for', 'improve this copy', 'headline help'.

skills.name: copy-editing
skills.purpose: Systematic multi-pass editing of existing marketing copy (clarity, voice, proof, specificity) and content refreshes.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'edit this copy', 'proofread', 'tighten this up'.

skills.name: content-strategy
skills.purpose: Plans content strategy: topics, pillars/clusters, blog strategy, content calendar priorities tied to search and buyer journey.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'content strategy', 'what should I write about', 'blog strategy'.

skills.name: humanizer-zh
skills.purpose: Chinese-language humanizer: removes empty phrasing, repetition and template expressions from Chinese articles while preserving facts and voice.
skills.how_to_use: Use on Chinese text; no prerequisites.

skills.name: internal-comms
skills.purpose: Writes internal communications in house formats: status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs and incident reports.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when asked for an internal update, newsletter or report; follows the matching example format in its examples folder.

skills.name: writing-shape
skills.purpose: Turns a raw-material markdown file (notes, fragments, transcript) into an article paragraph by paragraph: settles reader prerequisites, offers 2-3 openings, then grows and appends each block with deliberate format choices.
skills.how_to_use: Manual invoke only (disable-model-invocation); pass a markdown file of raw material and an output path.
skills.evidence: skills.sh ~406k installs and on the trending list (Sept/Oct 2026); 274k-star repo
skills.notes: Lives in the repo's 'in-progress' folder, so paths may move. Sibling 'writing-beats' (same folder) is a choose-your-own-adventure variant of the same exploit step.

skills.name: writing-fragments
skills.purpose: Explore phase of Matt Pocock's writing pipeline: interviews the author relentlessly and appends usable fragments to one markdown file, without imposing structure.
skills.how_to_use: Manual invoke; run before writing-shape / writing-beats. Asks once where to save the fragments file.

skills.name: article-writing
skills.purpose: Writes long-form articles, guides, tutorials and newsletter issues in a voice derived from supplied examples.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on long-form writing requests; feed it voice samples.

skills.name: brand-voice
skills.purpose: Builds a source-derived writing style profile from real posts/docs and reuses it across content, outreach and social.
skills.how_to_use: Give it existing writing samples; downstream skills consume the profile.

skills.name: content-engine
skills.purpose: Creates platform-native content systems and repurposes one source asset into X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube and newsletter versions.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on repurposing, content calendars, threads, scripts.
skills.evidence: Part of 271k-star ECC; listed on skillsmp

skills.name: content-creation
skills.purpose: Drafts marketing content across channels (blog, social, newsletters, landing pages, press releases, case studies) with channel formatting and SEO recommendations.
skills.how_to_use: Install Anthropic's marketing plugin; pairs with brand-review and draft-content.

skills.name: writing-dna-skill
skills.purpose: Distils a reusable 'Writing DNA' (language, structure, topic selection, evidence strategy, framing, visual style) from 20+ complete articles by an author or brand, then writes new pieces in that DNA.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on style-analysis / write-like-X requests; needs at least 20 full source articles. Bilingual (Chinese/English).
skills.evidence: 2.25k stars since late June 2026; on skills.sh /hot list
skills.notes: Frontmatter description is mostly Chinese; English README provided.

skills.name: brand-voice-enforcement
skills.purpose: Applies documented brand guidelines to any content generation so output stays on-brand; companion skills discover-brand and guideline-generation build the guidelines.
skills.how_to_use: Install the partner-built brand-voice plugin; triggers when writing branded content.

skills.name: avoid-ai-writing
skills.purpose: Audits and rewrites prose (READMEs, posts, release notes) to remove AI-isms.
skills.how_to_use: Install avoid-ai-writing plugin from wshobson/agents marketplace.

skills.name: content-production
skills.purpose: Full pipeline from blank page to publish-ready blog post/article/guide: research, outline, draft, edit, SEO pass.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'write a post about', 'draft an article'. Sibling content-humanizer skill handles de-AI pass.

skills.name: ai-copywriter
skills.purpose: Reader-first copywriter (headlines, microcopy, CTAs, subject lines, LinkedIn posts, strategic blog posts) combined with an anti-AI-tell humanizer pass.
skills.how_to_use: Single root SKILL.md; asks for ICP/category before writing.
skills.notes: Default branch has an unusual name (claude/humanizer-copywriting-skill-u5x4vd)

skills.name: sepia
skills.purpose: De-AI writing suite: repairs narrative architecture in fiction and routes professional prose (release notes, announcements, PR replies) through domain rules; sub-skills for review, rewrite, Hemingway-style edits.
skills.how_to_use: Install via skills CLI; invoke sepia or sepia-review/sepia-write.
skills.evidence: Created 28 Aug 2026, 2.9k stars in ~5 weeks (fastest-rising humanizer)

skills.name: content-research-writer
skills.purpose: Collaborative writing partner: researches, adds citations, improves hooks, iterates outlines and gives section-by-section feedback.
skills.how_to_use: Ask for help writing a researched article/blog post.
skills.evidence: In 76k-star ComposioHQ awesome list; copied to aitmpl.com
skills.notes: Repo has no license -> link only

skills.name: substack-ghostwriting
skills.purpose: Writes and grows Substack newsletters and web posts: voice matching, Notes strategy, email formatting, SEO, paid-subscriber growth.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on Substack/newsletter writing.
skills.evidence: samber/cc-skills (copywriting family also includes tone-of-voice creator with 3k installs)

skills.name: copywriting-tone-of-voice-creator
skills.purpose: Builds a brand tone-of-voice guide (TONE.md) with voice attributes, do/don'ts, tone matrix, lexicon and channel rules for downstream content skills.
skills.how_to_use: Run once per brand; other skills read TONE.md.

skills.name: blog-writing-guide
skills.purpose: Write/review engineering blog posts to Sentry's standards (voice, structure, quality bar) - a strong template for technical blogging.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on blog post drafting/review.
skills.notes: Sentry-specific conventions; adapt for your brand

skills.name: newsletter
skills.purpose: Plans and grows an email newsletter: content, subscriber growth, monetization (Substack/Beehiiv).
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'newsletter strategy', 'grow my newsletter'.

skills.name: content-repurposer-sms
skills.purpose: Turns one piece of content into multiple platform-native formats across text-first and visual-first platforms.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'repurpose', 'turn this into'. Uses a shared social-media-context file.
